text: よさげな　ポケモン　もって　ふらふら　あるいとる　おまえは？

structure.jp: よさげな　ポケモン　もって
ふらふら　あるいとる

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: よさげな　ポケモン　もって　ふらふら　あるいとる
patterns.explanation: A long phrase ending in a verb, put before a person, tells you which person is meant. ふらふら　あるいとる　おまえ = 'you, who are wandering around'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: とる is the old-man and western-dialect way of saying ている, which shows an action going on now. あるいとる is the same as あるいている = 'are walking'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て form of a verb can show the state you are in while doing the next thing. ポケモン　もって　あるいとる = 'walking around with Pokémon in hand'.
